summary: The official EPA fuel economy of every light-duty pickup on sale heading into 2027, turned into a yearly fuel bill at 2026 gas prices: small, midsize and full-size trucks, hybrids, the Duramax diesel, V8s, performance trucks and the electric Cybertruck. Every number comes from a published source, listed below.
sources: U.S. EPA fuel economy data (fueleconomy.gov), as published by MPG Buddy, 2026 model year pages: https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/ford/maverick-hev-fwd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/ford/maverick-tremor-awd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/ford/f150-pickup-4wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/ford/f150-pickup-2wd-hev/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/ford/f150-pickup-4wd-hev/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/ford/f150-raptor-r-4wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/ford/ranger-2wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/chevrolet/silverado-2wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/chevrolet/silverado-4wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/chevrolet/silverado-4wd-zr2/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/chevrolet/colorado-2wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/ram/1500-2wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/ram/1500-4wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/ram/1500-rho-4wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/toyota/tacoma-4wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/toyota/tacoma-hybrid-4wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/toyota/tundra-4wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/toyota/tundra-hybrid-2wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/nissan/frontier-2wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/honda/ridgeline-awd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/hyundai/santa-cruz-fwd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/jeep/gladiator-4wd/2026 , https://mpgbuddy.com/cars/tesla/cybertruck-long-range-20in-cyber-wheels/2026

note: Yearly fuel costs are our own calculation: 15,000 miles divided by the EPA combined rating, times $4.33 per gallon of regular (AAA national average, Oct 14, 2026) or $6.30 for diesel (AutoGuide, mid-October 2026). Premium-fuel trucks (Raptor R, Silverado ZR2) use MPG Buddy's figures at the EPA premium reference price of $5.48. The Cybertruck's $1,000 a year is MPG Buddy's estimate. Rivian R1T ratings come from MPG Buddy's 2026 peer listings.
